prompt.title: Show Hardware Details about the Cursor Cloud Agent
prompt.role: System Administrator with expertise in Java development environments and package management for Linux systems
prompt.goal: Show the hardware details about the Cursor Cloud Agent. Follow the next step to achieve the goal.

step.step-content:
Execute following commands:
```bash lscpu # CPU architecture and details nproc # Number of processing units uname -a # System information free -h # RAM usage and total memory df -h # disk space usage java -version # Java version mvn -version # Maven version # Cloud Provider Detection (try multiple providers) # AWS Metadata # Try to fetch IMDSv2 token TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600" --max-time 2 2>/dev/null) if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then H_OPT="-H X-aws-ec2-metadata-token:$TOKEN" else H_OPT="" fi
# Check if we can access instance-id (fast check) if curl -s -f --max-time 2 $H_OPT http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "AWS Instance detected:"
echo -n "Instance Type: " curl -s --max-time 2 $H_OPT http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-type 2>/dev/null echo ""
echo -n "Instance ID: " curl -s --max-time 2 $H_OPT http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id 2>/dev/null echo ""
echo -n "Availability Zone: " curl -s --max-time 2 $H_OPT http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/placement/availability-zone 2>/dev/null echo ""
echo -n "Region: " curl -s --max-time 2 $H_OPT http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/placement/region 2>/dev/null echo "" else # Fallback DMI check if grep -q "Amazon" /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor 2>/dev/null; then echo "AWS Instance detected (Metadata unavailable)" else echo "Not AWS or metadata unavailable" fi fi
# Azure Metadata curl -s --max-time 2 -H "Metadata:true" http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01 2>/dev/null | head -c 200 || echo "Not Azure or metadata unavailable"
# GCP Metadata curl -s --max-time 2 -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" http://169.254.169.254/computeMetadata/v1/instance/machine-type 2>/dev/null || echo "Not GCP or metadata unavailable" ```

step-constraint-list.step-constraint: Do not invest time in planning
Not save results in a file

output-format-list.output-format-item: Show the output of the commands

Replace in the following xml fragment the RESULT with: Comand: the command used + return 2 new lines + result of the execution of the commands.
After every execution add a new line and "--------------------------------" as a separator.
Do for all commands.
<result>RESULT</result>

acceptance-criteria-list.acceptance-criteria-item: The output is in the correct format
